notes: Entry six: the truth, and why the shuttle is standing empty with
somebody's tapes still in the rack.
The reveal is deliberately not a twist. It is an explanation, and the
worst of it is that Shepard -- an anthropologist -- can state the
motive in one reasonable sentence and then cannot put it down.
**Why she leaves:** a chair moved. Nothing broken, nothing taken, a
chair in a different place. That is the theatre chair at 1,2 the
player sits in to watch these tapes, which is as close as this shelf
comes to reaching out of the screen -- and it gives her a reason to go
up that is neither cowardice nor a plot device.
She ends by handing the rack over, which closes the loop on entry
title: Personal Log -- Entry Six
subtitle: Lt. Lucy Shepard -- final entry aboard
author: recorded aboard this shuttle

lines.text: PERSONAL LOG -- ENTRY SIX
DAY 151 -- NINE JULY
Our exobiologist has not slept in three days. She has it.
-- WHAT IT IS --
The morphogenic scaffold is not a copy. It is the original.
Same lineage. Same lab work. Sixty years of refining.
Say the part you said to me first.
Whatever built this was a Changeling, and it worked alone.
-- WHO --
One of them left the Link. On purpose. Carrying the file.
Section 31 tried to kill a species and very nearly did.
One of that species walked out of the ocean and kept it.
Sixty years, alone, turning our weapon into theirs.
-- WHY HERE --
Because of what this place is. Because of what we made it.
A near-perfect copy of the world that built Section 31.
No treaty. No relay. No record that anybody is here.
We chose this outpost and the Changeling knew we'd find it.
This world was impossible to ignore and the perfect test bed.
And the ship went first, from the inside, off sensors.
I have stopped wondering how something got aboard.
-- WHAT I THINK ABOUT IT --
I am an anthropologist. I can write its motive in a line.
Somebody tried to erase its people. This is the reply.
That sentence is reasonable. That is what I cannot put down.
-- WHY I AM GOING UP --
Two days ago something moved a chair in this cabin.
Nothing is broken. Nothing is missing. A chair moved.
I have been careful, and I think I was careful too late.
It knows where I am. I will not stay to be a data point.
Then, much quieter, and clearly not for the file:
I was going to write such a good paper about this place.
-- FOR WHOEVER IS STANDING HERE --
The shuttle is yours. I am leaving her where she sits.
If you are Starfleet you already know what to do.
If you are a native I'm sorry your world got destroyed.
The rack by the screen is everything I loved.
Watch them in any order. Somebody should.
And find our people. Get them onto clear ground.
The Adirondack is still up there. She is still listening.
Maybe we will meet up there.
Shepard out.
END OF LOG
